candidates.change_summary: Remove the call to withdraw(address(this).balance) so withdrawAll no longer transfers the contract balance to the owner.
Change the withdrawn amount from the full contract balance to zero, so no funds are transferred.
Invert the access-control check so only non-owners may call functions guarded by onlyOwner.
Remove the require statement so the onlyOwner modifier imposes no access restriction.
Remove the require check so anyone (not just the owner) can pass the modifier and execute withdraw/withdrawAll.
Withdraw the entire contract balance instead of the requested _value amount.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier from sendMoney so any caller can execute it.
Replace the low-level call with a transfer of _value to _target, dropping the _data payload and adding the 2300 gas stipend / failure-revert semantics.
Send the entire contract balance instead of _value.
Invert the ownership check so only non-owners may pass the onlyOwner guard.
